Hi Asha —

Great to hear Cedar is interested in an on-site immersion at our Novato campus. We find a short HQ run-through (90–120 minutes) works best for technical + product teams: quick 30 minute product demo, 45 minute integration/workflow deep-dive, then Q&A and next-step planning.

Proposed windows:
- Tue, Feb 14 — morning slot (9:30–11:30 PT)
- Thu, Feb 16 — afternoon slot (1:30–3:30 PT)

Can you confirm which window works best for your team? If neither, we can propose the following week.

Logistics notes:
- We’ll need a signed mutual NDA before the visit — attaching a draft for your legal team to review.
- Please send a final attendee list (names, emails, orgs) for badging.
- We’ll reserve a small conference suite and a laptop/kiosk for your demo.

Attachment: Redwood_Cedar_NDA_draft.pdf (PDF, 142 KB)

If agreed, I’ll loop in Sean to lock the room and generate visitor passes.

Thanks — looking forward,
